subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**with**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence describes the milkmaid's action of walking while carrying the pitcher: "as she was walking 4 the big pitcher full of milk on her head".
 
• The preposition "**with**" (साथ) is used to indicate accompaniment or the presence of something being carried or used.
 
• "Walking with the pitcher" clearly conveys that she was carrying the pitcher (which was on her head) as she walked.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

Complete Passage: *In a small village, lived a milkmaid (1) **who**__ sold the milk that she (2) __**got **__from her cows. She (3) __**would **__carry the milk in a big mud pitcher. One day, as she was walking (4) __with__ the big pitcher full of milk on her head, she started to imagine all the things she wished to do with the money she would (5)____ from selling the milk.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2: "on"** – While the pitcher is "on her head," "walking on the pitcher" is grammatically incorrect and nonsensical in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "in"** – "Walking in the pitcher" is also grammatically incorrect and illogical.
 
• **Option 4: "by"** – "Walking by the pitcher" means walking next to it, which contradicts the fact that the pitcher was "on her head."
